summary.ja: 核配置ごとに電子基底状態を収束させ、得られた力で核の古典運動を進める。
summary.en: Converge the electronic ground state at each nuclear configuration and propagate classical nuclei with its forces.

references.label: M. Born and R. Oppenheimer (1927), Zur Quantentheorie der Molekeln
references.scope: Publisher bibliography and DOI checked. Cited for the historical basis of Born–Oppenheimer separation, without claiming a full-text audit or reproduction of a modern MD implementation.

references.label: R. Car and M. Parrinello (1985), Unified Approach for Molecular Dynamics and Density-Functional Theory
references.scope: Publisher bibliography/abstract and original equations (3)–(5) and discussion of fictitious electronic motion near the BO surface consulted. The paper’s silicon dynamics have not been numerically reproduced.

assumptions: Classical nuclei and a selected adiabatic electronic ground state. A fixed-He₂ force-provider/local-Verlet check exists, while full trajectories remain unvalidated.
The published interface fixes the periodic cell, occupations and electronic model, and reconverges SCF at every visited geometry.
assumptions_ja: 核は古典力学、電子は選択した断熱的基底状態。固定He₂の力供給と局所Verlet確認があるが、軌道全体は未検証。
公開接続例は周期セル・占有・電子モデルを固定し、訪れた各核配置でSCFを解き直す。
units: Atomic units: energies hartree, forces hartree/bohr, positions bohr, time atomic units and explicit nuclear masses in electron masses.
units_ja: 原子単位：エネルギー hartree、力 hartree/bohr、座標 bohr、時間 原子時間、核質量 電子質量。
boundary_conditions: Choose isolated or periodic boundaries for the model; the published local interface uses the fixed periodic He₂ cell.
boundary_conditions_ja: モデルに応じて孤立・周期境界を選ぶ。公開した局所接続例は固定した周期He₂セル。

next_deliverable.ja: 解説・一次文献と既存の小規模例との対応を保守する。専用実装の追加は必要性が指定された場合に小さな教育用例から検討し、重い収束走査・独立参照の再生成・長時間MDは通常の作業へ含めない。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain the reading, primary sources and links to existing small examples. Consider a dedicated implementation only when needed, starting with a small educational case; routine work excludes heavy convergence sweeps, reference regeneration and long MD.

limitations.ja: BOMD全体の状態は解説のみ。別の力配布版で行った短いVerlet接続確認を、長時間軌道・温度制御の検証として数えません。
limitations.en: Overall BOMD remains reading only. The separate force release’s short Verlet interface check does not validate long trajectories or thermostats.

caution.ja: BOMD全体の状態は解説のみ。別の力配布版で行った短いVerlet接続確認を、長時間軌道・温度制御の検証として数えません。
caution.en: Overall BOMD remains reading only. The separate force release’s short Verlet interface check does not validate long trajectories or thermostats.
